people_count_bucket.instructions: How many real people are visibly present in the photo? Count partially visible people; exclude pictures of people. Choose unknown when occlusion or image quality prevents a reliable bucket.

capture_style.instructions: Does the photo appear candid or deliberately posed? Use mixed when both are substantial and unknown when intent cannot be determined.

contexts.event: Is this photo part of an organized event? Use supplied album context and visible evidence. Missing evidence is unknown, not false.
contexts.ministry_trip: Does supplied context explicitly establish this photo as part of a ministry trip? Do not infer religious affiliation from appearance. Missing context is unknown, not false.
contexts.family: Does supplied context explicitly establish a family occasion or family relationship? Do not infer kinship from appearance. Missing context is unknown, not false.
